description: The WebHop gateway as ASP.NET Core middleware: accept public HTTP traffic and forward it over reverse WebSocket tunnels that servers behind NAT open. Adds AddWebHopGateway() and UseWebHopGateway().

Serve an ASP.NET Core app through a WebHop gateway from behind NAT or a firewall, with no inbound ports: the app opens WebSocket tunnels to the gateway and Kestrel serves them. Adds builder.WebHost.UseWebHop().
